assumptions: R-455 is the unchanged finite coupled-vector parent interface and R-454/R-451 supply its scalar source envelope.
The finite coupled history, source vectors and defect vectors are nonnegative and measured in one declared positive weighted sup norm.
Every step transfer matrix has nonnegative entries and its weighted row sums are bounded by one common kappa_bar across the intended finite history.
The source and defect weighted norms obey ||u_R||_w<=A*r^(R-1) and ||d_R||_w<=D*s^(R-1), with common nonnegative A,D,r,s.
Diagonal conjugation, matrix monotonicity, induced-norm submultiplicativity and finite-sum identities are applied before any infinite-limit interpretation.
boundary: R-456 proves an abstract finite-dimensional coordinate-weight implication only: a positive weighted coupled recurrence with one common weighted row-sum bound has the R-455 source-plus-defect envelope. It does not supply a Q3 transfer law, owner weights, common domain, residual, exhaustion map or any physical or continuum identification.
evidence_level: T0 exact conditional finite positive weighted transfer-operator defect-resolvent envelope
missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK derivation of the coupled transfer matrices, the positive weights and a common weighted bound kappa_bar<1.
A source-owned weighted vector source/defect sequence and uniformity of its norm bounds in shape, volume, cutoff, beta, phase and history depth.
A common unbounded weighted operator or form domain on which all components, weights and transfer laws are defined.
A production all-shape exhaustion map identifying the same weighted observable across shapes and orientations.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, common alpha, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.
non_claims: No source-owned Q3LOCK transfer matrices, positive weights, componentwise recurrence, common weighted bound, vector residual or defect envelope are established.
No common unbounded weighted domain, form closure, source/volume/cutoff/beta uniformity or production exhaustion map is established.
The weighted finite envelope is not an OS/KMS/GNS, common-alpha, physical-sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap result.
The dimensions, weight patterns and radius rows are exact finite checks and are not an exhaustion surrogate.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order and promotion firewalls remain unchanged.
